step_a: Compare each aligned top/bottom panel cell by zero-versus-nonzero occupancy and construct the complete 4xW XOR-positive mask.
intermediate: The input-dependent XOR-positive coordinate set, partitioned into its 4-connected components with their sizes.
step_b: Read that component partition, select the largest component (all tied maxima for out-of-family inputs), and paint only its cells color 3.
why_b_depends_on_a: The component candidates and their sizes exist only after the aligned occupancy XOR is computed; replacing that intermediate with top-panel occupancy changes the selected component and final output.
